summary: Iteration 2 — Discover community EQ profiles + Waveform scrubber + Sleep Timer + Gapless toggle. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases PASS — GET /api/eq-profiles (default trending, ?sort=new, ?sort=stars, ?q=bass), GET by id (with 404), POST publish, POST star toggle (persistence verified via GET with user_id), GET /config (Equalizer APO format), seed idempotency confirmed (8 profiles seeded once; backend log: 'Seeded 8 EQ profiles'). Frontend: All required testIDs present and tappable. Player screen renders waveform-scrubber and sleep-timer-btn; sleep sheet shows all 6 presets (5/15/30/45/60/90), tapping sleep-15 activates timer and sleep-clear-btn becomes visible. Tap-to-seek on waveform does NOT crash with empty queue. Equalizer screen has open-discover-btn that navigates to Discover; discover-back returns. Discover shows 8 seeded profiles (9 after our prior tests created TEST_Bright_*); sort-trending/new/stars chips re-fetch list; discover-search input is functional; star-{id} optimistically updates (verified 0 → 1). Detail modal opens on card tap with apply-profile-btn / share-profile-btn / detail-star-btn; share does not crash on web; apply-profile-btn imports config to EQ context and navigates back. Publish modal accepts publish-name/publish-author/publish-desc, publish-confirm posts and prepends the new profile (verified TEST_UI_Profile_X appears at top after publish). Settings: setting-sleep opens sheet, setting-gapless row present, setting-discover navigates to Discover. No red-screen errors. Only console warnings observed are the same RN-Web deprecation warnings carried over from iteration 1 (shadow*/pointerEvents) — non-blocking.

minor.issue: Sort uses pre-stored star_count which is only updated on toggle_star. Newly created profiles default to star_count=0 which is fine, but if seed data ever inserts profiles with starred_by entries (it currently doesn't), star_count must be kept in sync. Currently consistent.
user_id is a query param (not used to attribute authorship). Author comes from request body. Minor — not a bug, just inconsistent with star endpoint which puts user_id in body.
Side-effect: increments downloads counter on every GET. RESTful purists would prefer POST /download. Acceptable for current scope.

react_native_issues.issue: discover.tsx imports 'expo-file-system/legacy' (same as equalizer.tsx). Legacy submodule will be removed in a future Expo SDK. Plan migration to the new File API. Reference: /app/frontend/app/discover.tsx:9

Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' carried over from iteration 1 (ClickWheel/GlassCard shadow styles). Non-blocking on web; native still needs shadow*. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ClickWheel.tsx, /app/frontend/src/components/GlassCard.tsx

Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Source: LinearGradient/BlurView overlays. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/discover.tsx:336 (toast pointerEvents="none"), /app/frontend/src/components/ClickWheel.tsx

action_items: (Optional) Migrate 'expo-file-system/legacy' imports in discover.tsx & equalizer.tsx to the new File API before next Expo SDK upgrade.
(Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow on web (Platform.select) to silence RN Web warnings.
(Optional) Move pointerEvents from props to style.pointerEvents on LinearGradient/BlurView/toast overlays.
(Optional cleanup) Test data: a few TEST_* profiles (TEST_Bright_*, TEST_UI_Profile_X) were created in MongoDB during this run; consider a cleanup script or filter them out in production.

(Optional) Validate true background-audio + lock-screen controls + sleep-timer auto-pause + gapless preload only in a real APK build (Expo Go / web preview cannot exercise native expo-audio playback).
(Optional) Consider a unique index on eq_profiles.id so that future seed/restart paths cannot create duplicates if the count check is bypassed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:148 — `_profile_to_out` re-uses `_profile_to_out(doc, user_id)` on the just-inserted dict; safe because `doc.pop('_id', None)` is called first.

server.py:121 — list_profiles uses pre-stored star_count for sorting (correct because Mongo can't sort by computed len(starred_by)). star_count is updated in toggle_star but NOT in create_profile — verified that create initializes it to 0, so this is consistent.
server.py:306 @app.on_event('startup') — seed runs only when count==0; idempotent across restarts. Verified backend log shows 'Seeded 8 EQ profiles' exactly once.

discover.tsx:53-68 — Optimistic star update reverts on failure but only restores the *single* profile from closure; if many parallel stars happen race conditions could occur. Acceptable for single-user UX.
discover.tsx:85 — applyToEQ does `setTimeout(router.back, 600)` which can fire after unmount; protected by Modal closing first. Low risk.
PlayerContext.tsx:122-138 — Sleep-timer/gapless effect re-creates intervals on every dependency change including durationSec; intentional to react to track changes. Verified UI doesn't crash.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 8 community EQ profiles on first startup (idempotent). During this test run we also created 2 TEST_* profiles via publish POST (TEST_Bright_<hash> from pytest, TEST_UI_Profile_X from Playwright) — both visible at top of ?sort=new as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend env variable is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Pytest harness honors either via fallback. The Discover screen lives at /discover (Expo Router) and is reached via either the 'Discover' badge on the Equalizer screen (open-discover-btn) or the setting-discover row on Settings. The sleep-timer sheet is rendered by SleepTimerSheet component and is opened from both Player header (sleep-timer-btn) and Settings (setting-sleep). The gapless toggle is a Switch inside the setting-gapless row; tapping the row itself does not toggle — only the Switch element does. Native expo-audio playback / lock-screen controls / true background audio remain untestable on web preview — must be validated in APK build.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All listed flows pass end-to-end.
